name: vacuum-compiler
description: Roadmap #11: the vacuum compiler, executed — circuits compiled into the ground state of a Feynman-Kitaev Hamiltonian, with the machine-certificate layer and the energy ledger the claim never came with. Known in theory (FEY85 clocks, KSV02 Ch. 14, KKR06 QMA-completeness; LLO96 simulation) — never machine-verified as a compiler with a readout cost audit. Delivered here: the compiler certificate (H|psi_hist> = 0 to machine precision for random circuits, ground-state degeneracy accounting, input/output penalty checks); exact conditional readout (measuring the clock at step t hands you U_t...U_1|psi_in> with fidelity exactly 1); the spectral gap law with the path-Laplacian closed form 1-cos(pi/(T+1)) as anchor; and the honest ledger — static storage costs zero work but every readout path pays (uniform clock marginal => (T+1)·log2(T+1) expected erasure bits; a fuel tilt buys success probability and dirties the conditional state at O((eps/gap)^2); the free clock walk never garbles the program but rarely delivers it). The wall, stated plainly: the vacuum stores and attests computation, it never beats running it
